definitions.explanation: The act of both parties moving toward each other's position to reach an agreement. Emphasizes mutual effort and willingness to find common ground.

examples.japanese: {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧
examples.english: to show a willingness to compromise

examples.japanese: ⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Compromise from both sides is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Both countries showed a willingness to compromise in order to end years of conflict.

notes:
USAGE: Often used in expressions like {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show willingness to compromise) or {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is compromise). The related verb ⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る→歩み寄る：13197_ayumiyoru⟧ means "to approach" or "to compromise."

NUANCE: {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り emphasizes the mutual nature of compromise—both parties meeting in the middle rather than one side simply giving in. It has a positive connotation of cooperation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (attitude of compromise)
- {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show willingness to compromise)
- ⟦{相互|そうご}→相互：04045_sougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り (mutual compromise)
- {歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no willingness to compromise)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{譲歩|じょうほ}→譲歩：09143_jouho⟧ (concession - more one-sided)
- ⟦{妥協|だきょう}→妥協：07423_dakyou⟧ (compromise - more general)
- ⟦{折|お}り{合|あ}い→折り合い：09144_oriai⟧ (compromise, settlement)
